title: Respect Affects Gameplay
description:
GitHub: https://github.com/xiting910/RespectAffectsGameplay


Stops STS2 from blindly marking the game as "modded" just because any mod is loaded, intelligently evaluating each loaded mod to determine whether it truly affects gameplay.

• Save path isolation: scans every loaded mod's DLL assemblies to detect actual game content such as cards, relics, heroes, powers, enemies, and other persistent gameplay data. If no content mods are present, your saves stay in the vanilla directory even with other mods loaded. Pure code, UI, and QoL mods no longer force your saves into the modded folder.
• Non-save functions: uses a broader check (a mod's affects_gameplay flag or content detection) to control everything else, such as the "MODDED" label in the main menu, Sentry error reporting, telemetry uploads, and debug/developer features.
• Mod flag warnings: if a mod is marked affects_gameplay: false but contains game content, a Toast notification appears at the main menu listing all flagged mods.
• Smart save migration: prevents pure utility/UI mods from triggering unnecessary save copies, and automatically triggers a copy when a content mod is first loaded to ensure saves are migrated correctly.
• IsRunningModded() interception (optional): when enabled, all callers of ModManager.IsRunningModded() are controlled by the current mode, covering the "MODDED" UI label, Sentry reporting, telemetry, debug console commands, .run file drag-and-drop, and more.
• In-game settings page: all options configurable via RitsuLib's settings page.
• Multi-language support: built-in English and Simplified Chinese translations. Support for adding new languages by placing a JSON file in the user data directory.
• Verbose logging toggle: optional detailed logs for troubleshooting.
